Definition: from G4253 and G1492; foresee:--foresee, saw before.
BiblicalUsage: Proeido means to foresee, to see before, and Peter uses it once for David. Seeing this before, David spoke of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither did his flesh see corruption.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe David saw the resurrection a thousand years before it happened, and the Psalms are prophecy, not only poetry.
